metadata.description: Practical Claude Code skills for keeping live systems healthy: cost, logs, pipelines and bugs.

plugins.name: ops-toolkit
plugins.description: All four ops skills in one install: cloud cost scan, incident diagnosis from logs, CI/CD failure triage and bug fixing with proof. Read-only, with a guard hook that blocks cloud changes and secret reads.

plugins.name: bug-resolve
plugins.description: Fix an ordinary bug properly: failing test first, root cause not symptom, smallest fix, and fail-before / pass-after proof.

plugins.name: cloud-cost-scout
plugins.description: Find cloud waste in Azure or AWS from read-only exports: a ranked, dollar-quantified savings list with risk, owner and the safe fix. Never changes resources. Includes the read-only guard hook.

plugins.name: log-detective
plugins.description: Diagnose incidents from App Insights / Log Analytics / CloudWatch / GCP or log files: onset, new errors, latency regressions, the deploy just before, and the implicated code lines. Read-only. Includes the read-only guard hook.

plugins.name: pipeline-doctor
plugins.description: Diagnose failed Azure Pipelines / GitHub Actions runs: the root error (not the exit-code cascade), who can fix it, and the fix as a pull request or owner request. Read-only on CI. Includes the read-only guard hook.
